{{Infobox auto|title=Elegy of Hyacinthus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Elegy of Hyacinthus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Zephyr]] I. It is crafted from four wind charges, three feathers and a [[Hyacinth]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/zephyr.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Elegy of Hyacinthus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Elegy of Hyacinthus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Zephyr applies to boots. At level I, sneaking gives Jump Boost VII. Levels II and III, which add Slow Falling and a charged updraft, are not given by any recipe, trade or loot.

In 1.12.2 the book does not store Zephyr itself but <code>main:zephyr</code>, the enchantment's id before the pack moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace. Its tooltip line reads "ERROR: Please wear me to update".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/enchantment/zephyr.json}}</ref> The old enchantment applies to boots like Zephyr and does nothing by itself, but the first tick the boots are worn, it is replaced with Zephyr I.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_zephyr.json}}</ref> Because the old enchantment's maximum level is I, two elegies cannot be combined into a level II book. Instead, the conversion adds to any Zephyr the boots already have: applying a second elegy to boots with Zephyr I gives Zephyr II once they are worn, and a third gives Zephyr III. Two boots with the same level of Zephyr can also be combined in an [[anvil]].

== Trivia ==
* In Greek myth, Hyacinthus was loved by Apollo and by Zephyrus, the west wind, and the hyacinth flower grew from his blood when he died. The recipe uses a [[hyacinth]] (the pack's name for the allium) and wind charges.
* The developer chose the myth of Apollo, Hyacinthus and Zephyrus as a personal reference: hearing it at about age 11 was the first time they had encountered queer men in any story.<ref>{{Cite video|id=wavOi0ULYpQ|title=How Criticism changed Matcha Flavoured|quote=that was the first time I'd ever been exposed to like uh queer men in in media of any kind}}</ref>
